name: Promotion ask
trigger: push to TEST, weekend CVC list, QSM, PROD deploy
notes: Tracker status changes follow process/cvc-reopen-ticket.md and happen only when Ben asks for that ticket.

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: Someone asks to move code to another environment; master asks the client agent what is ready.

steps.name: What is ready
steps.means: The client agent lists each CVC ticket and whether it is ready to move.
steps.gate: result lists each CVC and its status

steps.name: Approve the moves
steps.means: Ben names which tickets to move.
steps.gate: Ben names the tickets to move

steps.name: CVC ticket moves
steps.means: The client agent moves only the tickets Ben named, and records the moves.
steps.gate: only tickets Ben named; no comments on tickets

steps.name: QSM ticket
steps.means: Ben submits the QSM ticket to QAD; QAD installs.

steps.name: Confirm install
steps.means: The client agent checks the install landed in the target environment.

steps.name: Reply
steps.means: The client agent drafts the reply saying it is installed; nothing is sent.

spec.goal: Draft the reply to the client email this case answers ({root_title}), from the finished step's result.
spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} with fields ["verdict", "evidence", "pointers", "summary"]; the case's intent is {intent}.
constraints: Nothing sends: write the body to a file and return the draft_reply envelope.
The body ends with 'Thanks!' and no name; Ben's Outlook signature carries it.
Promise nothing no task covers; if the answer needs more work, put it in follow_ups instead.

steps.name: Send
steps.means: Ben sends the reply; that closes the case.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 9 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)
